title: ONE of the bowls has been great, but one chipped
text:
ONE of the bowls has been great, but one chipped. UPDATE: Turns out the lid was fine but one of the bowls chipped with less than a year of minimal use. So, it's not that durable. Essentially, I paid $40 for the use of one bowl. The bowl that has chipped MAY have been used 4 times. I don't put food in chipped glassware for obvious safety reasons (also, the chip is on the rim so I guess that would also eventually, if not already, cause a breach in the seal). So, I guess paid 40 bux for 1 food storage bowl and one shallow planter. 🙄😐 ...and of course, you have to go hunting for product warranty because it doesn't make sense to add it to the product's page. I've purchased other food safe glass storage from more reliable companies. Razab won't get my business again.

Old Review: I will update with pictures later. I'm not yet secure with this product. So far, no leaks detected but the top does not feel secure or strong. It doesn't have a locking hinge closure. The plastic of the top bends and the locking doesn't feel secure. I feel fine putting food in it for the fridge (& I have done so) but I haven't transported anything very brothy because the top feels so week and seems like it'll open on me.

Once I prepare something that won't make too big of a mess when transported, I'll try this. The size is ok. It seems more shallow than the pic suggests. It looks great for making a casserole tho.

Good luck
